questions.question_text: Explain how tourism can affect the environment of a region. [4]

marking_scheme.rubric: AO2: Explain environmental impacts of tourism.
keywords_required: Negative: Construction of hotels/airports destroys natural habitats.
Air travel and increased traffic cause air pollution and carbon emissions.
Litter, plastic waste, and untreated sewage can pollute local waterways/beaches.
Positive: Income from tourism can be used to fund conservation (e.g. national parks, protecting endangered wildlife from poachers).

questions.question_text: Put the following words into the correct place on the Butler Model: Involvement, Decline, Consolidation.

keywords_required: 1. Exploration -> 2. Involvement -> 3. Development -> 4. Consolidation -> 5. Stagnation -> 6. Decline (or Rejuvenation)

questions.question_text:
Which stages of the Butler Model can be described as:
a) a major change in direction or focus that happens to attract a new type of tourist.
b) the tourist destination is well-known but is no longer a destination of choice.
